facts.claim: go/go.mod and go/Dockerfile are the only paths that changed since v1.9.1. The module's go version moves from 1.26.8 to 1.26.9, and the image's builder from golang:1.26.8-alpine to golang:1.26.9-alpine, pinned by the digest sha256:cdfd4fe2da6b225d8b40c6b7a105736e548e83ff56d5d8f9394446eeb5eb84e0. Go 1.26.9 fixes vulnerabilities in net/http, net/textproto and crypto/tls (GO-2026-6603, 6605, 6607 to 6613 and 6617) that govulncheck reports as reachable from this source built with Go 1.26.8; built with Go 1.26.9, govulncheck finds none. The release run for v1.9.1 failed on that govulncheck report before it published anything: it staged no release and pushed no image.

evidence.source: go/go.mod; go/Dockerfile; git diff v1.9.1..HEAD; govulncheck v1.5.0; release workflow run for v1.9.1

facts.claim: The confirmed review release-v1.9.0 covers v1.8.0..55e7790c1ef5, and release-v1.9.1 covers v1.9.0..1b3ba722cb59; v1.9.0 and v1.9.1 add only those reviews' own files. Together they describe every change this source carries since v1.8.0 apart from the toolchain.

No Go source file, console file, document or workflow changed since v1.9.1: the binary is built from the source v1.9.1 builds, by Go 1.26.9 instead of Go 1.26.8, and it embeds v1.9.1's console bundle.

Exploratory run run-20261009T002917-y2uxpv of draft llm-gateway, the draft that became contract da05219969e0, against a binary built by Go 1.26.9 from ab32648eb548 and served with LLMGW_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_API=1 as the release smoke serves it, passed all ten assertions.

For source revision ab32648eb548ea90c6ba92e8cdb85d50430c59c1 built by Go 1.26.9: go build, go vet, gofmt, staticcheck, govulncheck, go mod tidy -diff and go mod verify pass, as does go test for every package; go test -race passes for every package on linux/amd64; and the deterministic Docker acceptance passes all 31 checks against an image built from it with the new builder on a Linux engine, where its digest policy does not apply to a locally built candidate. The console's typecheck, 212 tests, npm audit and dist rebuild check, the documentation check, actionlint, the acceptance-policy tests (19) and the roster script tests (78 passed, 1 skipped) pass on 55e7790c1ef5, whose console, documents, scripts and workflows this source carries unchanged.

evidence.source: local and remote Linux test execution

conclusion.summary: The release ships v1.9.1's source, which was tagged but never published, built by Go 1.26.9, which fixes net/http, net/textproto and crypto/tls vulnerabilities govulncheck reports as reachable from it built by Go 1.26.8. No source changed since v1.9.1, and the confirmed release-v1.9.0 and release-v1.9.1 reviews describe the changes since v1.8.0. Every accepted proposition holds for this source, and the exploratory run, the unit tests, the race run and the Docker acceptance exercise them.
